items.html: And the matter is that in holy Atzilut there was correction in all of it, and then the aspects of the hairs of AA were corrected in his head, and there were drawn from him, at the back of his shoulders, that whiteness, and that tuft of hair that includes the four corrections of the strands and the hairs, and they are drawn down to the head of ZA, as mentioned in the discourse of the Tzitzit. It is found that Aba and Ima are covered within those hairs, which are white as pale snow. And through this Yaakov remained a smooth man, for all of Atzilut was already corrected, and all the hairs are above, in Aba and Ima. But Yaakov remained in the aspect of a smooth man, who is ZA of Atzilut of holiness.
